name: studio
description: A film crew of AI agents that turns a topic into a finished explainer video, vertical (1080x1920) or wide (1920x1080): writer, director, test-screening critic and editor produce a kinetic-typography MP4 with captions, optional free local AI narration and upload metadata. The trend desk films a trending tool from real screenshots and makes a wide video plus a Short. Local rendering with Pillow and ffmpeg.
